requirements.evidence: SpiritualToolsRegistry requires every supported spiritual tool kind exactly once.
SpiritualToolKind.tarot and Tarot domain primitives exist independently.
TarotSpreadDefinition.oneCard and deterministic draw assembly support a one-card reading.
TarotSpreadDefinition.threeCard preserves three independent spread positions.
TarotSpreadDefinition accepts arbitrary non-empty position data for future modular spreads.
Tarot interpretation entries require source/version/editorial-policy provenance and the draw engine has no hidden RNG or random filler text.
IChingReadingProvider is a separate provider contract with method/source/version provenance.
MoonCycleGuidance consumes a pre-resolved phase and keeps astronomy/editorial provenance separate.
IntentionPractice is an independent spiritual practice primitive.
DailyIntention binds an intention to an explicit YYYY-MM-DD local date key.
MeditationContent is a versioned/source-tagged content primitive with positive duration.
BreathworkContent requires instructions, safety note, version and source provenance.
